items.fullMessage:
Update wxPython to 4.3.2 (#20983)

Follow up #20882
Summary of the issue:

NVDA currently uses wxPython 4.3.1, based on wxWidgets 3.3.3.
wxPython 4.3.2 is the latest stable release and is based on wxWidgets 3.3.4.
Description of user facing changes:

    On Windows, wxMSW now handles Esc after IME and native controls, fixing affected IME and native-control interactions. See wxWidgets PR #27148.

Description of developer facing changes:

    Updated wxPython from 4.3.1 to 4.3.2.
    wxPython 4.3.2 is based on wxWidgets 3.3.4.
    Major upstream updates include:
        improved generated .pyi type stubs;
        a fix for wx.html2.WebView.New returning a Python-owned window with newer SIP versions;
        official Python 3.15 wheel support;
        removal of Windows 32-bit wxPython wheels.
    The Windows 32-bit synthDriverHost environment does not depend on wxPython.
    See the official wxPython 4.3.2 changelog for the complete list of changes.

Description of development approach:

    Updated the wxPython pin in pyproject.toml.
    Regenerated uv.lock from the wxPython 4.3.2 package metadata.
    Updated the current developer change log entry.
    No NVDA source changes were required; the wxPython 4.3.1 accessibility adjustments from PR Update wxPython to 4.3.1 #20882 are already present in the base branch.
